invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null list of records to perform bulk insert.
The instantTime parameter is likely required to identify the commit instant; thus, should not be null or empty.
records is statically typed as List<HoodieRecord<T>>, so this should always be true at entry.
instantTime is statically typed as String, so this holds.
It is reasonable to expect that the list does not contain null elements for a write operation.
